types.name: Word analogy
types.description: Meaningful English words linked by meaning (A : B :: C : ?, or pick the word-pair with the same relationship), such as worker and tool, part and whole, synonym or antonym.

types.name: Letter-cluster analogy
types.description: Letter-clusters or words where letters are shifted, reversed or rearranged (PDK : QFN :: SJQ : ?, WOLF : FLOW, or # and % to be found); the meaning of the words does not matter.

types.name: Number-pair analogy
types.description: Two or three pairs of single numbers related by arithmetic (4 : 49 :: 6 : ?, or "17 is related to 21 following a certain logic").

types.name: Number-set (triad) analogy
types.description: Sets of three or four numbers in brackets such as (24, 15, 120); asks for the set whose numbers are related in the same way.

types.name: Word-to-number analogy
types.description: A word or letter-cluster is paired with a number (CAT : 24 :: DOG : ?), usually from letter positions, their sum or product, or the count of letters.

types.name: Figure analogy
types.description: Figures: figure A is related to figure B, and the same change must turn figure C into the answer figure.
